title: Initial evaluation, hip, catching getting into car

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Patricia. Tell me about the hip.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Groin and outer hip pain when I walk more than ten minutes. Pain is about 5 out of 10.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I get a catch when I put my foot in the car.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Let's check hip motion. Internal rotation is 20 degrees on the right, and 30 on the left.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Any night pain, fever, or weight loss?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No night pain. I've lost a few pounds from dieting, on purpose.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Thanks. Any numbness down the leg?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I'm not testing strength today. I need to warm you up first.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: start side-lying hip exercises and a walking limit of ten minutes. We'll test strength and reassess in two weeks.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay. I don't have a particular goal yet.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: We can set one together next time.

expectedFacts.statement: Groin and outer hip pain walking more than ten minutes
Catch when putting foot in the car
